{"id":1593746379,"question_id":3154,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 3 months","timestamp":1743553024,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1593746379/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Value of an Ordered Triplet I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long maximumTripletValue(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        int max_val = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<n-2 ;i++)\n        {\n            for(int j=i+1 ; j<n-1 ;j++)\n            {\n                for(int k = j+1 ; k<n ; k++)\n                {\n                    int val = (nums[i]-nums[j]) * nums[k];\n                    max_val = max(max_val , val);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    return max_val;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-value-of-an-ordered-triplet-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":524}
